about_the_game:
The rich and diverse branches of the plot and the choices you can make are the unique charm of this game. When facing the difficulties imposed by noble people, will you handle them skillfully or accidentally offend them? When participating in the preparation of a palace banquet, will you stand out with your intelligence and talent or stay quietly in the background? Every decision is closely related to the direction of your fate. If you accidentally discover a secret in the imperial garden by chance, will you keep it to yourself or take advantage of it to climb up the social ladder? Different choices will lead to completely different endings. You may be honored and become a favorite beside the imperial concubine, or you may make a mistake and be demoted to the cold palace. Life and death are on the line, and everything depends on your strategy and wisdom.

Game Features

1. High Degree of Freedom in Plot Choices: The game allows you to decide the fate of yourself and those around you through interactive ways such as rolling dice and making binary choices. Whether you want to become a powerful minister in the court or a chivalrous person in the Jianghu (martial arts world), it's all in your hands.

2. Rich Character Interaction and Romance Options: There are numerous characters that can be romanced in the game. By increasing their favorability, you can start a romantic relationship with the character you like. Meanwhile, your interactions with the people around you will also affect the plot development and the ending of the game.

3. Diverse Plot Branches: The game is divided into multiple gameplay modes such as the "Harem" chapter, the "Female Official" chapter, and the "Marriage by Imperial Order" chapter. Each mode has unique plots and endings waiting for you to explore.

Game Rules

Dice Rolling and Decision Making: The game frequently includes dice-rolling segments where the dice points trigger different storyline branches and events.

Interact with Characters to Unlock Routes: The game features numerous characters with distinct personalities and statuses for players to pursue, including the emperor, princes, generals, imperial physicians, scholars, and more. Players need to interact frequently with these characters through chatting, gift-giving, completing tasks together, etc., to increase their favorability.

Money-Making Modes in the Economic System: The game offers multiple ways to earn money, such as receiving rewards for completing tasks, investing in shops, and participating in business activities.
